description: Refactor app routes into server-first, composable modules with explicit client boundaries, suspense/error handling, and preserved behavior/API contracts.

userStories.title: Standardize App Router architecture boundaries
userStories.description: As a developer, I want server/client boundaries to be explicit so routes stay performant, resilient, and maintainable.
acceptanceCriteria: Define and apply a route-local structure that defaults `page.tsx` and non-interactive sections to Server Components.
Use Client Components only for interactive islands (forms, controls, local UI state), with clear prop boundaries from server parents.
Add route-level or section-level suspense boundaries for async data regions (`loading.tsx` and/or `Suspense` fallbacks) where they improve UX.
Add route-level error boundaries (`error.tsx`) or equivalent scoped handling for recoverable failures in major routes.
Break large route features into focused components/hooks/utilities without mandating a single `*-route-root.tsx` wrapper pattern.
